content: A primary metabolite is a type of metabolite that plays a direct role in essential physiological processes such as normal growth, development, and reproduction. In contrast, a secondary metabolite does not directly participate in these fundamental processes but often serves a significant ecological function. If you are interested in contributing to this topic, you are encouraged to apply to become the Editor-in-Chief for this subject. There can be one or multiple Editors-in-Chief. Alternatively, you may apply to serve as an Associate Editor-in-Chief for one of the subtopics related to this area. To express your interest, please send an email indicating whether you wish to serve as the Editor-in-Chief for the entire topic or as an Associate Editor-in-Chief for a specific subtopic. Be sure to include your CV and/or a biographical sketch as part of your application.
